title: Metadata reference manifest (v0.14 F-2)
description: Curated whitelist of .NET BCL assemblies Calor programs may bind to. Generated by scripts/generate-metadata-references-manifest.sh; consumed by src/Calor.Compiler/Binding/Metadata/MetadataContext.cs. Drift outside sdkVersionRange is a hard failure at load time; SHA drift inside the range triggers the auto-regen path.

sdkVersionRange.description: SDK version range this manifest is valid for, format 'MIN - MAX' (inclusive).

generatedFrom.description: Absolute path the manifest was generated from (informational).

assemblies.description: One entry per whitelisted BCL assembly.

assemblyName.description: Assembly file name without the .dll extension.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the assembly file, lowercase hex.
